title: Haunted Fridays: Stone Arch Brewpub has ghosts on the menu
excerpt: There's been brewing at the Stone Arch building since 1858, and that has brought its fair share of ghost stories to the premises.
content:
APPLETON, Wis. (WBAY) - Stone Arch Brewpub, a building that has brewed beer since 1858, has accumulated ghost stories over the years, according to owner Steve Lonsway.

Lonsway has been with the business since the beginning and said he and his staff are familiar with reported paranormal activity there.

“We’ve had at least five different teams come in. One, only one said that there wasn’t a ton of evidence, but a couple of them said there’s overwhelming evidence,” Lonsway said.

Reported incidents

Lonsway described several incidents reported at the brewpub.

“There’s been stories of one gentleman came in and went into the back room, and the napkins were, fell off a top shelf, but they’re all sprawled out in a rainbow form. That just doesn’t happen that way. From somebody sitting at the bar seeing a tray being thrown at them, and the noises that are associated with that, but there’s no tray,” Lonsway said.

“Right behind this wall is a storage area. We call it the dungeon. There’s some staff members that won’t go back there,” Lonsway said.

Action 2 News reporter Aaron Anastos went to the storage area referenced by Lonsway.

“To be honest, of all the dungeons I’ve been in, this isn’t even the bottom ten- it’s more of a storage room than anything- but some employees are scared to come back here after hearing of some strange goings on,” Anastos said.

A ‘friendly ghost’

The brewpub has given the reported ghost a name: Charlie.

“Fortunately, whatever it is, it’s not negative. It seems to be a friendly ghost,” Lonsway said.

Lonsway said patrons have shown interest in the stories as well, with some visiting in hopes of encountering the ghost.

“I’ve had stories of, like, husband and wife, come down, and they both are going to have dinner, but the one time the lady wanted to go find the skull, so he sat and ate alone for an hour while she was walking all over the building,” Lonsway said.

Stone Arch Brewpub continues to operate, marking more than 160 years of brewing history in the building.
